problem_type: Legacy map presence is mistaken for complete document coverage during canonical migration
symptom: Without a canonical owner, an empty or partial retired map masks a valid active single plan; successful canonical save/reload removes its last active payload copy.
direct_cause: The migration chooses old map OR single plan. It never checks whether the parsed map actually contains the active document, and unreadable entries are logged then discarded.
class_root: Every legacy document must be accounted for before canonical-only emission: migrate valid data, respect authoritative canonical ownership, or reject destructive normalization. Container existence does not establish per-document migration coverage.
affected_population: Mixed retired per-document map and single-plan projects
Empty/partial legacy maps with an active plan
Malformed legacy map/plan/commit fields formerly silently discarded
entry_points: readLocalProject -> owner hydration -> session writer -> saveLocalProject -> JSON reload
internal_only_reason: This is an internal persisted-data ownership invariant, confirmed by the independent reviewer and actual repository/source reads. Existing plan schema, canonical owner and storage lifecycle decide it; no external API behavior is assumed.
invariants: Canonical map including explicit empty canonical ownership stays globally authoritative
Without canonical ownership, preserve all valid old map documents and fill only a missing active document from the valid single plan
Never overwrite an existing mapped document with the single projection
Validate legacy map shape, entries, plans and commit flags and single-plan/commit fields before dropping raw projections; malformed required legacy data fails closed
Only canonical fields are saved; do not restore dual-owner projection output
Preserve all documents/media results/reference and table source identities/Film Bible/user meta, prompts, false and zero; no input mutation

door_reduction.why_not: Repository read/save and normalizer record decoding are distinct legitimate entry points. They already share normalizePayload; repair migration coverage there without introducing another writer.

generality_proof: The real-store/real-repository round-trip harness executes empty-map and partial-map source through actual write and JSON reload before checking the active plan, with two documents, synthetic image/video results, table links and Film Bible intact. Mapped-active/canonical mixed controls prove no overwrite or resurrection. Negative matrices exercise malformed legacy combinations through normalize and real save and require unchanged original stored bytes.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Account for every legacy document before canonical-only output; reject unrepresentable damaged input

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both real paths normalize raw input; regression executes them with isolated in-memory Web Storage rather than mocking save.
Existing full-owner hydration/writer is unchanged and participates in real round trips and receipt checks.

recurrence.reason: Any historical mixed representation can have incomplete map coverage or invalid entries; map existence cannot prove successful migration for the active document.
same_class_scan: Read independent-review-7b52f6529-fresh-20261025.md and verified the a773-related files are unchanged from 09221429e

prevention.invariant: Only a complete validated migration or authoritative canonical source permits canonical-only save.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing active map coverage uses the validated single plan; malformed legacy data throws before a successful write can replace the original record.
prevention.strategy: Replace map-versus-single branching with per-document completion and remove warning-then-skip paths.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove exclusive old-map/single branching and unreadable-entry skip behavior; do not reintroduce old projection output.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse existing Zod plan parsing and project owner/repository APIs; no dependency or schema relaxation.

migration: Existing load/save performs lazy migration. Valid mapped documents keep their content and single-plan fallback fills only missing active coverage. Damaged legacy input is not guessed or silently rewritten; no daily project is opened.
residual_risks: Malformed legacy data is rejected, not repaired or recovered from backups
Actual Electron filesystem/App/Provider/PNG/full-suite acceptance remains unrun
